Projects

01
Project 01: Tools & Skills
Base44 · Ongoing
Built the tools section from scratch , how users connect apps and give the agent new skills.
Chat tools permission
1 / 7
Problem
Giving an AI access to your apps is a big trust moment. The feature had been there since day one , but with no real design behind it.
Approach
Show users exactly what they're turning on, before they turn it on. Step by step, with clear language.
02
Project 02: Settings
Base44 · Shipped
Owned the full settings experience , credits, security, and everything users want to understand about their agent.
General settings
1 / 6
Problem
Users didn't know what the agent knew about them, how much they were spending, or how to change anything. Settings felt like a scary, confusing place.
Key Insight
Settings isn't just a list of options. It's the place users go when they want to feel in control , every question they have about their agent should be answered here.
03
Project 03: Agent Memory
Base44 · Ongoing
How the agent remembers what it learns about you across every conversation.
Agent memory
1 / 1
Problem
Users had no idea what the agent remembered about them, or how to change it. It felt like a black box , distant and hard to trust.
Key Insight
Dumping raw data on users makes them anxious. The fix was organised memory , grouped clearly, easy to edit, easy to delete.
04
Project 04: Library
Base44 · Ongoing
A home for all your assets, and the context your agent needs to work well.
Chat web preview
1 / 3
Problem
When the agent does real work, users need to share files with it. But there was no way to see or organise what the agent had access to , everything was hidden.
Approach
A place for users to store all their assets, and for the agent to get the context it needs. Files become shared knowledge, not just uploads.

Project 05: Wix Vibe
Wix · Shipped

Add section prompt
1 / 4
What it is
Wix Vibe is a vibe coding website builder. You describe what you want in plain language, and the AI builds a full working site. I was part of the core team for over a year.
My Focus
What happens after the AI builds the first version? I owned that part , the editor, manual tools, and how to let users stay in control inside an AI-first product.
